target.title: fix(usage): preserve provider-billed zero totals
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Follow-up to #97047 after the direct DeepSeek V4 zero-cost regression was fixed on `main`.

The remaining accounting gap is that `usage.cost.total: 0` is ambiguous in persisted transcripts:

- it can be a fabricated placeholder zero from a transport/catalog path, which should be recomputed or treated as missing when pricing is known/unknown; or
- it can be an authoritative provider-billed total from a provider billing endpoint, including a legitimate free/zero-cost route.

OpenRouter is the concrete provider-billed case: its generation metadata endpoint returns `total_cost`, and that value is the provider's billing total. When `total_cost` is `0`, core usage aggregation should preserve it only when the transcript carries explicit provenance proving that the zero came from provider billing.

## Why This Change Was Made

The earlier follow-up approach was rejected because it guessed from provider/model ids and treated every known-priced all-zero row as authoritative. This version follows the maintainer guidance instead:

- no DeepSeek/OpenRouter model ids are hard-coded into core usage accounting;
- OpenRouter, as the provider owner, marks generation-metadata totals as provider-billed;
- core aggregation uses a generic provenance signal rather than provider-specific policy;
- rows without provenance keep the current `main` behavior, so suspicious known-priced zero totals still get recomputed.

## What Changed

- Add `usage.cost.totalOrigin?: "provider-billed" | "estimated"` to the usage/cost type contract.
- When OpenRouter generation metadata lookup succeeds, set:
  - `usage.cost.total = data.total_cost`
  - `usage.cost.totalOrigin = "provider-billed"`
- Teach session usage-cost scanning to preserve recorded zero totals when `totalOrigin` is `provider-billed`.
- Keep the existing protection for provider-reconciled zero totals with nonzero cost components.
- Keep existing recomputation/missing-cost behavior for unproven all-zero known-priced/unknown-priced rows.
- Bump the durable usage-cost cache version from 6 to 7 because recognized cost-total provenance changes cached total semantics.

## Evidence

Current PR head used for this proof update: `d94a866db584795872e27fae0b2b72dd4baac7fc`. The code patch was intentionally left unchanged; this update only adds current-head evidence and review context.

Regression coverage added/updated:

- `extensions/openrouter/index.test.ts`
  - nonzero OpenRouter generation metadata cost is marked `provider-billed`
  - zero OpenRouter generation metadata cost is marked `provider-billed`
  - failed/oversized generation metadata lookup keeps the streamed estimate and does not set provider-billed provenance
- `src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts`
  - provider-billed all-zero cost total with known pricing remains zero in summary, durable cache, and session logs
  - known-priced transcript rows without provider-billed provenance still recompute from catalog pricing
  - version-6 durable cache entries are stale under the new provenance-aware semantics

Real transcript-path proof on a test server, exact head `d94a866db584795872e27fae0b2b72dd4baac7fc`, collected 2026-07-07 UTC:

- checked out PR #101177 at `d94a866db584795872e27fae0b2b72dd4baac7fc`
- created a redacted JSONL transcript under `agents/main/sessions` with:
  - provider: `openrouter`
  - model: `openai/gpt-5.5`
  - total tokens: `15000`
  - `usage.cost.total: 0`
  - `usage.cost.totalOrigin: "provider-billed"`
- ran the production session usage summary/cache/log path against that transcript
- observed result:
  - `loadCostUsageSummary`: `totalTokens=15000`, `totalCost=0`, `missingCostEntries=0`
  - `loadCostUsageSummaryFromCache`: `totalCost=0`, `missingCostEntries=0`
  - `loadSessionLogs`: `tokens=15000`, `cost=0`
- result: provider-billed zero total stayed zero in the real transcript summary, durable cache, and session-log spend path

Sanitized proof output:

```json
{
  "inputTranscriptUsage": {
    "provider": "openrouter",
    "model": "openai/gpt-5.5",
    "totalTokens": 15000,
    "costTotal": 0,
    "costTotalOrigin": "provider-billed"
  },
  "summaryTotals": {
    "totalTokens": 15000,
    "totalCost": 0,
    "missingCostEntries": 0
  },
  "durableCacheTotals": {
    "totalCost": 0,
    "missingCostEntries": 0
  },
  "sessionLogRow": {
    "tokens": 15000,
    "cost": 0
  },
  "proof_result": "passed"
}
```

GitHub Actions evidence on exact head `d94a866db584795872e27fae0b2b72dd4baac7fc`:

- `Real behavior proof` succeeded: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28823621558
- `CI` succeeded: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28822961427
  - includes successful `preflight`, `security-fast`, `build-artifacts`, `check-lint`, `check-prod-types`, `check-test-types`, `check-dependencies`, guard checks, and node compact shards
- Additional successful security/path checks on the same head include CodeQL, OpenGrep PR diff, Dependency Guard, Security Sensitive Guard, Workflow Sanity, and Socket Security checks in the PR status rollup.

Local targeted validation on the pushed head, before this proof-only body update:

- `git diff --check -- src/agents/usage.ts packages/llm-core/src/types.ts src/infra/session-cost-usage.types.ts src/infra/session-cost-usage.ts src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts extensions/openrouter/stream.ts extensions/openrouter/index.test.ts`
- `CI=1 NO_COLOR=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts extensions/openrouter/index.test.ts`
  - `src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts`: 66 passed
  - `extensions/openrouter/index.test.ts`: 46 passed

Evidence source map:

- OpenRouter generation metadata provenance: covered by OpenRouter regression tests and the `extensions/openrouter/stream.ts` change that marks successful generation metadata totals as `provider-billed`.
- Provider-billed zero preservation through transcript aggregation: covered by the test-server transcript-path proof and session-cost regression tests.
- Durable cache compatibility: covered by the cache-version bump from 6 to 7 plus regression coverage that treats version-6 cache entries as stale under the new semantics.
- Placeholder-zero safety: covered by regression coverage showing known-priced transcript rows without provider-billed provenance still recompute instead of being accepted as authoritative zero.

## Relationship to Closed PRs

This supersedes the closed #97134 and #101163 follow-up attempts. The closed PRs tried to resolve the conflict by scoping behavior from core. This PR instead adds the explicit provenance contract requested in review.

## Current Head / Base Status

The current PR head is `d94a866db584795872e27fae0b2b72dd4baac7fc` on `fix/usage-cost-provenance-zero-total`. This proof update does not rebase, merge, or alter the code patch. GitHub currently reports the branch as behind latest `main`; the evidence above is bound to the exact current PR head.

## Risk

Low-to-moderate behavior risk, limited to cost accounting for transcript rows with `usage.cost.total: 0`.

Expected behavior after this change:

- Provider-billed zero total with explicit `totalOrigin: "provider-billed"`: preserved as authoritative zero.
- Known-priced placeholder zero without provenance: recomputed from catalog pricing.
- Unknown/all-zero pricing with nonzero tokens and no provenance: still reported as missing cost.
- Positive recorded provider costs: preserved by existing behavior.

No workflow, dependency, lockfile, secret, or release artifact changes.

## Review Context Addressed

- Latest ClawSweeper review requested real behavior proof that a provider-billed zero total is preserved in a real transcript usage summary or spend path. The test-server proof above exercises the transcript summary, durable cache, and session-log spend path on exact head `d94a866db584795872e27fae0b2b72dd4baac7fc` and shows the provider-billed zero stays zero.
- The review called out the optional `usage.cost.totalOrigin` API/cache contract and cache-version semantics. This body keeps that surface visible: the contract is optional, the durable cache version is bumped from 6 to 7, and older version-6 cache entries are treated as stale and rebuilt.
- No provider/model-specific core policy was added; the core behavior remains provenance-based.
- No code changes were made for this proof update.

## Not Tested / Limitations

- This follow-up proof did not perform a live paid OpenRouter API call. The live provider-fetch path is covered by the OpenRouter regression tests; the added real-behavior proof uses a redacted transcript row carrying OpenRouter/provider-billed provenance through the production transcript summary/cache/log path on a test server.
- The branch is behind latest `main`; no rebase or code change was made because this update is evidence-only.
